# 3.2 Functions and reactivity {.unnumbered}

## Story problem

**Filter Auckland zones and update the map**

- A user selects a subset of SA2s.
- The summary table updates immediately.
- The Folium map refreshes without recomputing everything.

## What you will learn

- Define inputs and outputs cleanly.
- Use reactive calculations to avoid repeated computation.
- Structure your app so the Folium map updates predictably.

## App architecture

- Load data once
- Use pure functions for transformations
- Use reactives for filtered views
